instruction: Please act as a professional verilog designer. Design a module that implements a 4-bit magnitude comparator using only one 4-bit adder. The module should have two inputs (A and B) and three outputs (EQ, GT, LT). EQ should be high if A and B are equal, GT should be high if the magnitude of A is greater than B, and LT should be high if the magnitude of A is less than B. You are only allowed to use one 4-bit adder in your implementation.
